title: Oracle Credit Risk Gauge Deteriorates After Earnings Report
content: A measure of Oracle Corp.’s credit risk climbed on Wednesday after the database company posted a jump in spending on data centers and other equipment, raising fresh doubts about how quickly it can generate profit from its huge investments in artificial intelligence.

title: Argentina Stages Market Comeback With Local Dollar Bond Sale
content: Argentina sold local-law dollar bonds in a move seen as a first test of a planned comeback to global credit markets as Javier Milei’s administration seeks funding to meet hefty sovereign debt payments coming due next year.

title: Asia Centric: SoftBank’s AI Gamble – Bold Vision or Risky Bet?
content: SoftBank is doubling down on artificial intelligence with a $30 billion commitment to OpenAI and ambitious plans for Stargate – even as risks mount. After a 200% surge earlier this year, shares tumbled 40% in November when Google’s Gemini 3.0 gained traction, threatening ChatGPT’s dominant position in the AI race. title: AllianceBernstein’s: Debt Repricing Signals Rising Risks
content: William Smith, AllianceBernstein senior vice president and director of credit, says repricing in the debt markets reflects rising risks. He tells Romaine Bostick and Katie Greifeld on “The Close” that uncertainty around payback periods, CapEx and its financing is creating a healthier dynamic for debt investors. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Signa Founder Benko Found Guilty of Hiding Watches in Fraud
content: Rene Benko, who built a $27 billion global property empire that spanned New York’s Chrysler Building to London’s Selfridges department store, was found guilty of hiding some luxury watches from creditors in a second set of Austrian insolvency fraud charges.
